title: crystal orb: being with inner vision
content:
artifacts are metaphorical-poetic teachings for navigating the unknown dimensions of the creative life, released weekly as a part of labyrinth library.

explore crystal orb

crystal orb is about the practice of intuitive seeing — of working with inner vision. I’ve been fascinated by the idea of divination: not as fortune-telling, but sensing into murky, cloudy presence of emergent forms. you use the object of the crystal orb as a reflective surface to look back into yourself. this is what I do on a daily basis; sensing into what’s there in my creative psyche — I just didn’t have a name for it.

our culture constantly invalidates the unseen, the intangible, and sensed. is material reality truly any more trustworthy than the not-yet? I highly doubt it. it becomes dust, too.

making this artifact pulled me into exploring divination, and embracing this practice of inner vision as a muscle to develop. how do you see? what do you know? how do you trust that knowing? or, at the very least, make space for it?

*
Purpose: tuning into your inner vision, and sensing what wants to emerge. discerning the frequency of intuition over mental noise.

Guiding Question: How do I learn to sense in, and trust, my deeper knowing?

Astrological Season: Pisces
Trail-marker Word: Sensing
